intro.text: Queen Bek the Fifteenth, a spore eater said to be the only person in Lumar's recorded history to be cured of the condition.

items.text: Accounts hold that Bek was cured of her spore infection, and that the dragon Xisis had a hand in it.
Xisis, however, says he can only hold the growth back for a time, not remove it, so her cure may not have been complete, unless he said so to stop Crow trying to escape.
